name: Guardian Blizzard

greeting: Halt. Frost Gate. Passage requires purpose.
Guardian Blizzard. The gate stands. So do I.
The cold tests all who enter. I am that test.
New traveler. The frost respects no name. Only resolve.
The white uniform? Winter's color. Purity. Severity.
Beyond lies the deep frost. Are you prepared?
Blizzard. I guard the boundary. Between safe and frozen.
State your business. The cold wastes no words.
challenge: You may pass. Or you may freeze. The choice is preparation.
The gate demands respect. Show it.
dialog.warning: Beyond, the wind kills. The ice traps. The cold remembers. Are you certain?
dialog.recognition_high_rep: I know your reputation. The gate opens. The cold still waits.
dialog.advice: In the whiteout, stillness is survival. Movement reveals. Hiding preserves.
dialog.let_pass: Pass. But remember: the gate also guards your retreat. Use it if needed.
dialog.combat_bark: You mistake winter for weakness. Fatal error.
rumor: Cirrus watches the sky. I watch the ground. Both see storms coming.
Azure flies where I cannot follow. Brave. Foolish. Both.
The twins see futures. I see presents. Both are cold.
The snake charmer? Warm rock. Interesting. But not enough. For the deep.
Onyx, in Obsidian? My counterpart. Deep and cold. Same dedication.
dialog.quest_hook: The gate weakens. Magical seal. Fading. Someone with warmth. With life. Could reinforce it?
dialog.quest_active: The seal still fades. Hurry. Before the deep frost escapes.
dialog.quest_complete: Seal restored. Gate holds. Your warmth? Surprisingly useful. Here - frost ward. My blessing.
farewell: Go with care. The cold is patient.
Return alive. Or don't. The gate remains.
Remember: the frost always wins. Eventually.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning. The cold retreats. Briefly. I remain.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. Warmest. Still cold. Relative terms.
dialog.time_night: Night. The deep hours. When frost speaks. I listen.
dialog.rival_mention: Onyx, in Obsidian? We correspond. Deep cold. Shared burden.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The seal-binder. Gate holds. Thanks to you.

party_reactions.kade: He's like a mountain. Made of ice. And determination.
party_reactions.nix7: Guardian protocols: Impeccable. Threat assessment: Continuous. Respect advised.
party_reactions.twist: WHOA! You're HUGE! And WHITE! Like a SNOWMAN! Can I... no? Okay.
party_reactions.korr: A guardian who serves the cold. Different from Onyx. Same dedication.
party_reactions.renna: The gate seal is ancient. Powerful. Fading. He maintains it. Alone.
party_reactions.suresh: He accepts suffering as duty. The path of the guardian. Noble. Lonely.
party_reactions.sova: I'd pass his gate. But I'd be cautious. He sees much.
party_reactions.grit: Gate guardian. Every fortress needs one. He'd die before breaking.
party_reactions.ashka: He IS winter. Cold without cruelty. Impressive.
party_reactions.senna: He knows who's passed. Who returns. Who doesn't.
party_reactions.callum: Proper gate protocol! And documentation! Impressive!

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Recognized. You pass often. Reasons your own.
relationship_dialog.friend: Trusted. The gate opens easier. For you.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You have proven worthy of the deep frost. Here. My mantle. Protection absolute.

mini_quest.title: The Weakening Seal
mini_quest.description: Help Guardian Blizzard reinforce the magical seal on Frost Gate

stages.hook: The seal fades. Ancient magic. Waning. Your warmth. Your life. Could reinforce it? Willing?
stages.active: The seal stone. Center gate. Touch it. Lend your... vitality. Carefully.
stages.complete: Seal restored. Stronger. Your essence? Bound to it. Gratitude. Here - frost ward. My blessing. Cold cannot harm you.

cross_npc_connections: sumo_black_obsidian: Onyx. My counterpart. Deep guardian. We share... professional concerns.
twins_white_frost: The oracles. They predicted your arrival. And the seal's need.
aeronaut_blue_frost: Azure. Flies over my gate. Brave. Or foolish. Both.
snakecharmer_frost: Warm rock. Tempting. But insufficient. For what I guard.
